title: Pump and vessel fundamentals
description: Trace the flow path between two vessels, inspect equipment, and move liquid from V-101 to V-102 by lining up valves and starting the transfer pump.
learningObjectives: Identify vessels, a pump, valves and instruments on a simple P&ID.
Understand how opening a valve and starting a pump establishes flow.
Relate valve position and pump state to the resulting process behaviour.

tasks.text: Line up the valves and start P-101 to establish flow (FT-101 > 0.5) within 2 minutes.
Transfer liquid until the Receiving Tank (LT-102) reaches at least 30%.

completionFeedback.onPass: Well done — you traced the flow path and completed a pump transfer from V-101 to V-102.
completionFeedback.onFail: The transfer wasn't completed in time. Check that both valves are open and the pump is running, then try again.

safetyConstraints: Do not start the pump with both suction and discharge valves closed (dead-headed operation is unsafe in real plants).
